name: hermes
notes: Skills install under $HERMES_HOME/skills/nskills/. Nested directories become categories.
Workflows install as skill bundles in $HERMES_HOME/skill-bundles/.
Agents install as loadable instruction skills because Hermes has no file-based agent registry.
Copies are the default because Hermes warns when a skill resolves outside its trusted skills directory through a symlink.
